device: Vendor_3697_Product_0001 (IR receiver), TCL Smart TV Pro (G05)
note: Scancodes are KeyEvent.getScanCode() as seen by an accessibility key filter (`RemoteKeyService`), not the raw MSC_SCAN from `getevent -lt` - on this board the two differ (gear: MSC_SCAN 0xf30/3888, but KeyEvent.getScanCode() 561, keyCode 4077; TV: MSC_SCAN 0x16d, but KeyEvent.getScanCode() 365, keyCode 4001). The gear and app-button scancodes match the same board's note in docs/devices/tcl-55c728-g05-4k-gb.md (Netflix 566, Prime Video 752). Native buttons are listed for reference and never intercepted.
